label: needs_human
rationale: Adds per-user credential injection for shared HTTP/SSE MCP servers: a `user_auth` block in the out-of-tree extensions config maps DeerFlow user ids to credential header values (`$ENV_VAR` references), and a built-in interceptor rewrites that header on every tool call from the run-time user, after OAuth in the interceptor chain; the server entry's static headers now serve only startup tool discovery. The agent's tool list is already assembled at run time by langchain-mcp-adapters from that same out-of-tree config, so neither the servers, the tools, nor the credential a given call carries can be enumerated from the repository.
